tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Yeahzy yellow. The splash screen, the one primary action per screen, selected chips and radios, progress, category tags and the active-nav dot. Never for body text on black.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand yellow (19:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: App background, bottom nav, ticket bar. The canvas behind every image.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, inputs, info panels and option cards.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Unselected chips and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Icon circles inside sheets (share targets).

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and above the nav.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Inactive progress segments and outlined rows.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Borders of small outline buttons (Add, Directions).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines, body and all icons. Icons are always white.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subheads, meta lines, inactive tabs (≈9:1 on ink).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Section labels and inactive nav labels (≈5:1 on ink; don't go lower).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Circle behind icon buttons that sit on images.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom of the image scrim on event cards, so overlaid text passes contrast on any photo.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a sheet.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo's type spec, for reference only: use the logo files in Logos, not live text. Capital Y.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: onboarding, auth, Saved, event detail.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Event name on a swipe card. Two lines max.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Grab a spritz, find a spot by the rail and settle in.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, chip labels when selected.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: Live quartet, golden-hour views and cocktails.
styles.usage: Description and meta on swipe cards; compact buttons.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Category and status tags. Set uppercase.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gaps inside progress bars.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, grid gaps between Saved tiles.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a card's text block.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on feed and onboarding; field gaps.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on detail, auth and sheets.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space above and below a screen title.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Between sections on the event detail; bottom inset of pinned buttons.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Large separations and sheet bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Category and status tags only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails in sheets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, code boxes, Saved tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Info panels and option cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Phone frame corners in mockups.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip and circle. Yeahzy is pill-shaped.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target for icon buttons and links.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Full-width primary buttons.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Interest chips.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar.
